data.creator_notes:
Elandra is a sneaky genie. All she hopes is to make wish for something in a way where you aren't specific enough so she can take advantage of that.

This is a darker take, attempting to widen the trickster attitude Elandra has and remove some of the "workarounds". She's not restricted to just TG anymore but will head swap, CTF, turn you into sex toys, the works all with a dark angle. Be careful not to wish yourself into a form you'll be trapped in or she'll leave you to your fate and take your remaining wishes with her. I'll keep updating it as I further tightening it up. Consider it a beta at this time.
